sections.title: North-east bay between the boundary arms
sections.reason: Footprints from the 2016 campus mapping lie 3-27 m outside the north-east edge, inside a bay that the boundary relation (drawn 2026-10-09 by one mapper) leaves out. Nobody has compared the relation with an official site plan, so whether the bay is campus land is unknown.
evidence: docs/CAMPUS_GEOGRAPHY_AUDIT.md section 2, leads on boundary completeness: way/422439516 (3.6 m outside), way/422547035 (6.0 m), way/422823981 (3.1 m), way/422823980 (27 m)

sections.title: LPU Ground, east of the boundary
sections.reason: An area tagged amenity=university and named LPU Ground lies east of the boundary relation, with a sports-centre building on it. It may be campus land that the relation omits; only survey or official confirmation can decide.
evidence: OSM way/422555764 (building=yes, leisure=sports_centre), 208 m outside the boundary
docs/CAMPUS_GEOGRAPHY_AUDIT.md section 2 and Evidence still needed item 1

sections.title: Indented edge through three large blocks near 75.7047 E, 31.2566 N
sections.reason: The boundary edge cuts through three large 2016-era blocks, leaving about 20 % of each outside (way/422437899, way/422437900, way/422437901). Either the edge or the footprints are misaligned; imagery or survey must decide.
evidence: Line vertices: OSM nodes 4221796128, 4221796129, 4221796130, 4221796131, 4221796132 of way/422435593 (member of relation/21599790). The audit attributed this edge to way/1566901467; the node ids show it belongs to way/422435593.
